body:
Triage: `needs-user-decision`, `domain:engine`, Task — acting on this reverses the remaining half of the #5748-pinned verdict (`a SCALAR data.id still outranks where and multi`), and a pin flip on a ruled behaviour is the manual floor regardless of how small the diff is.

[facets-block]
- 实际业务需求:仓内测量(PR #11229 的 ingress 普查)显示没有任何一处会构造「标量 payload id + 非标量 where.id」这对矛盾——现时痛感为零;但 SDK 外部调用方可以写出它,写出即静默丢谓词与 `multi: true`。
- 项目长远合理性:这是「静默丢弃⇒响亮拒收」家族(#5748 operator-objects、#11009 多余键、#11142 不等标量)收口后**最后一个**静默臂;留着它,家族不变量就带着一个例外,例外会被当先例引用。
- 防 AI 写代码犯错:静默丢谓词正是 AI 批量犯错被掩盖的温床——AI 生成的调用方写出矛盾对时,响亮拒收当场教会它,静默丢弃让错误数据落库。四轴中本轴最重。
- 创业阶段不扩散需求:改动极小(dispatch 判定处加一个拒收分支 + 翻一条 pin);不是能力扩张,是家族一致性收尾。

**一句话问题**:by-id 更新路径上「标量 `data.id` 旁站着非标量 `where.id` 谓词」这最后一个静默丢弃形状,是补进响亮拒收家族,还是按「payload id 即行地址、矛盾对太罕见」接受留存?

| 选项 | 代价 |
|---|---|
| **1** 响亮拒收(同家族错误码/文案),翻转 #5748 pin 的剩余半条 | 反转一条已裁 pin(须按翻转纪律:删除/反转断言,⛔ 不修绿;随卡带全仓 pin 清扫两句);外部调用方若依赖旧静默行为会开始收到拒绝 |
| **2** 维持现状,把「deliberately silent」写进边界注释与 pin 文案,家族宣言带一个具名例外 | 家族不变量永久带例外;未来读者需要知道为什么这一臂例外 |

**推荐 1**(置信度高):四轴同向——防 AI 轴与长远轴强推,业务轴的「零仓内构造」恰好说明拒收的破坏半径为零,创业轴成本可忽略。裁决格式:回「1」/「2」;1 ⇒ 晋级 `pm:queue`(engine 席,派发词按 pin 翻转纪律带全仓清扫条款),2 ⇒ 关闭本卡、注释+pin 文案的具名例外化开 S 卡。

## Maintainer ruling recorded (atomic four-part write)

Ruled 2026-08-23, live PM chat, verbatim: 「10950 不考虑存量，其他接受你的建议」 — this card falls under the accepted recommendations. **Ruled: option 1** — the scalar-`data.id`-beside-non-scalar-`where.id` shape joins the loud-refusal family (same error-code/wording family as #5748/#11009/#11142). `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in the same stroke. Dispatch riders (pin-flip discipline): the remaining half of the #5748 pin (`a SCALAR data.id still outranks where and multi`) is deliberately REVERSED — delete/invert the assertion, never green-wash it; the dispatch carries the repo-wide pin-sweep two-liner.

**Claim** — engine seat, session `session_01RfyXxZ2WPjcjhuXpiQQc3y`, branch `claude/issue-11230-scalar-data-id-nonscalar-where-refusal`. `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` in one label write, read back.

Dispatched on the maintainer's ruling of 2026-08-23, recorded on this card. Quoted verbatim, not paraphrased:

> 「10950 不考虑存量，其他接受你的建议」

⇒ **option 1**: this shape joins the loud-refusal family (same error-code and wording family as #5748 / #11009 / #11142). The dispatch order carries the two riders the ruling attached, and both are stated to the dev as non-negotiable:

1. **The remaining half of the #5748 pin is deliberately REVERSED** — `a SCALAR data.id still outranks where and multi`. Delete or invert the assertion. ⛔ Never green-wash it, never adjust it until it passes. A pin that was ruled to flip must visibly flip.
2. **The repo-wide pin sweep two-liner rides along**, so no other pin is left asserting the old silent behaviour.

## The seam this card will hit, named before it is hit

#11142 — the immediately preceding member of this family — landed in `packages/objectql/src/engine-update-dispatch.ts`, `packages/metadata-core/src/engine-update-dispatch.ts` and `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, **and appended to `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`**. That last file is `domain:spec` territory, and whether cross-lane error-code ledger appends are pre-approved as a class is a standing open question this seat has already raised (#6017).

Instruction to the dev: **follow the #11142 precedent exactly** — same family, same mechanics, and the ruling itself says "same error-code/wording family" — and name the spec-file touch prominently in the PR body so the spec seat can object on the record if it disagrees. ⛔ Do not invent a new error code shape, and ⛔ do not touch anything else in `packages/spec`.

## Scope note

The card's own four-axis analysis measured **zero in-repo constructors** of the contradictory pair, which is what makes the blast radius of refusing it approximately nil — an external SDK caller can still write it, and today that silently drops both the predicate and `multi: true`. That is the argument, and it is the card's, not an inflation of it: the business axis reads "no present pain", and the case rests on the AI-error axis and family consistency.

## Serialization

Dispatched alongside **#11374** (driver-sql MySQL schema sync), which shares no file with this card. All 10 currently-open PRs are in spec / docs / rest / qa — none touches `objectql` or `metadata-core`. Measured.

⚠️ **#11293 is deliberately NOT dispatched in this batch.** Its landing site (hook-body `ctx` accessor) is not yet established, and `metadata-core/src/engine-update-dispatch.ts` — this card's file — appears in the hook-dispatch grep. Rather than assert a disjointness I have not measured, that card waits for the next round. This seat made exactly that mistake earlier today on #11201 and is not repeating it.

Duplicate probe, both legs positive-controlled: no open PR claims this number, and `git ls-remote origin 'refs/heads/*issue-11230*'` is empty against **98** live `*issue-*` branches.
